message:
Autopilot breaks Warden shields; smoke test covers the whole cast

The test now fails unless the run meets a Leech, Mirror and Warden, every
Echo generation gets a personality, and the round-3 Warden is beaten.

Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01XsosCU4UKXGr6GkjHGAQmD

Wave director: leech packs, mirrors from round 3, Warden boss ends round 3+

New characters get a 1-second name card on first appearance; every drone
gets a hit flash and death burst; the predictability meter pulses when a
Mirror or Echo lands a prediction-based hit.

Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01XsosCU4UKXGr6GkjHGAQmD

Add Leech, Mirror and Warden characters

Leech: pack chaser that drains score on contact, dies in one hit.
Mirror: walks your exact path from two seconds ago and fires at where the
model predicts you'll be, punishing repeated routes.
Warden: shielded elite with radial volleys; dashing through its ring
opens it for a few seconds.

Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01XsosCU4UKXGr6GkjHGAQmD

Echo personalities: each generation takes a trait from your data

Strafer, Dasher, Sniper, Brawler, Turret or Wildcard is picked from the
recorded playstyle (avoiding repeats when another trait is nearly as
strong). The trait tunes that Echo's speed, fire rate, dash, aim and HP,
shows on its nameplate, and drives the round banner line, e.g.
"GEN 2 — THE STRAFER learned that you circle counter-clockwise."

Add SELF PLAY: an arena shooter where a neural net learns how you play

SELF PLAY is a three.js twin-stick arena shooter for the Cambridge x Arcade
AI Hackathon 2026 by Team Kanban (Awaiz Ahmed).

- Round 1 records 15 of the player's decisions per second; a from-scratch
  MLP (16-24-24-11, Adam) trains on them in the browser and spawns an
  "Echo" clone that plays like the player.
- The same model predicts the player's next move: live predictability
  meter, prediction ghost, and Echoes that lead their shots.
- Playstyle profile (archetype, radar, concrete habits), multi-generation
  rounds, and share links that pack the 6-bit quantised weights into the
  URL for serverless duels.
- Kanban Studios sketch-brutalist UI, procedural WebAudio, touch and
  gamepad controls, single-file esbuild bundle (index.html).
- Deterministic trailer pipeline under video/.
